column3: Termination of Employment of Workmen
(Special Provisions) (Amendment)
(3)  Every  application  for  the  issue  of  an
order  in  the  nature  of  a  writ,  made  under
subsection  (1)  shall  be  supported  by  a
certificate under the hand of the Commissioner-
General  to  the  effect  that  the  security  as
specified  in  subsection  (2)  has  been  duly
furnished by such employer.
(4) The Commissioner-General shall cause
to  be  deposited  the  sum  as  specified  in
subsection (2), in an account bearing interest,
maintained by the Commissioner-General, in
any approved bank in Sri Lanka.
(5) The Commissioner-General shall refund
the sum furnished under subsection (2) together
with the interest on such sum to the relevant
party in terms of the final  determination of the
application  to  the  Court  of  Appeal  or  the
Superme Court, as the case may be.”.
